title: Forward Deployed Engineer
tagline: Full-stack, AI and DevOps skills plus the customer-facing craft needed to ship real solutions on site.

credit.text: Based on the Forward Deployed Engineer roadmap from roadmap.sh (personal use)

phases.title: Introduction
phases.description: Understand what a forward deployed engineer does and how people usually move into the role.

phases.title: Full-Stack Skills
phases.description: Be able to build and run complete applications for customers across the frontend, backend and Linux.

phases.title: DSA & System Design
phases.description: Master algorithms and system design, the first hurdle in most FDE interviews.

phases.title: AI & DevOps Skills
phases.description: Build AI-powered features and deploy them reliably on a major cloud with infrastructure as code.

phases.title: Discovery & Scoping
phases.description: Turn a customer's needs into a well-scoped, sequenced plan with honest tradeoffs.

phases.title: Business Acumen & Communication
phases.description: Understand the customer's business, manage stakeholders and communicate clearly in writing.
